findings.title: [P1] Parse `cached.value` instead of the metadata object in `loadProfile`
findings.body: `Cache.get` now returns `{ value: string; stale: boolean } | null` (src/cache.ts:5-6), but the hit branch does `return JSON.parse(cached)` (src/profile.ts:20) on the whole object. On every non-null cache hit, `JSON.parse` coerces the object to `"[object Object]"` and throws `SyntaxError`, so the cached fast path — the primary path after the first load of any profile — always fails instead of returning the cached profile. It is also a TypeScript type error (`JSON.parse` expects `string`). Parse the inner field: `JSON.parse(cached.value)`.
